input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves User, Employer roles. It manages core business objects including extraction, example book, extract request body, register request body. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to create and manage extraction records, so that I can track and organize extraction data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage example book records, so that I can track and organize example book data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage extract request body records, so that I can track and organize extract request body data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage register request body records, so that I can track and organize register request body data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage login response body records, so that I can track and organize login response body data effectively.
